detail: M3 mechanical remains frozen. M3-E requires four green foundations before Gateway, UI, and launcher integration: Host identity, Host pairing coordinator, Relay provisioning, and Browser vault/pairing.
Browser pairing TypeScript compilation failed and one initial full Relay test run failed; ownership was reassigned or returned for focused repair. No readiness claim advanced.
Browser vault and pairing tests 9/9, full remote focused tests 45/45, TypeScript compile, and production build passed. Independent audit remains required.

Host identity audit found secret-copy zeroization and unsafe bare delete lifecycle P1s. Relay audit found missing v2 cleanup lifecycle and startup/shutdown race P1s. Both were dispatched for focused rework; product gate remains NO-GO.
Frozen architecture permits non-overlapping Gateway join boundary and pairing UI implementation in parallel with foundation rework. Provider E3 and physical phone remain NOT_RUN.

Host identity, E1 pairing coordinator, and Relay lifecycle passed independent review. Gateway reached 97 tests and UI reached 29 tests with TypeScript/build green. Browser timestamp and reproducible runner rework remains active.

Architect dispatched Product Host E2 integration with exclusive ownership for the shared gate, exact UDS pairing routes, Relay provisioning client, durable pending-vault binding, startup compensation, and active remote binding.

E1.2 pairing coordinator stopped writing at sha256 51357d49e43f121fe7c54b7763c65ad9d977905c6088eeafda1d7ddc737429e0 after 19 focused tests and ten durable stress rounds. E2b bootstrap stopped writing at sha256 4a48949e8ae09427e6dab24b2748a730191984a49a4f3024da147b621a07cd1e after 31 focused tests. Independent E1.2 audit is active.

Remote ingress may not reacquire DeviceCommandGate or infer device keys. Architect and Product Host owner were dispatched to expose projection_locked and execute_locked under the existing guard, with journal-backed authoritative receipts. Launcher work remains gated on E2b and E2c freeze.

Exact frozen hash 51357d49e43f121fe7c54b7763c65ad9d977905c6088eeafda1d7ddc737429e0 is BLOCK P1. Crash after DeviceAuthority replaces A with B but before JoinSessionStore atomically tombstones A and advances B leaves store A Active/B Prepared against authority B Active; recovery compensates B but leaves stale A and permanent Conflict. Targeted durable replacement intent and exact crash-injection test dispatched.

Mailbox readiness wait moves from ProductStockHost construction into bootstrap orchestration: construct Host, obtain remote authority, start E2c, await E2c ready, then publish external Host ready. No component may self-signal readiness.

Independent audit PASS/FREEZE. Terminal receipts atomically clear pending command and frame; reload reaches exact retry before poll; pending suppresses new command capability and never maps to OutcomeUnknown. Full Web 287/287, TypeScript and production build passed.

E2/E2c now use explicit Receipt, RetryableNoAck, and Fatal dispositions. Deterministic Host rejection and OutcomeUnknown become bound receipts; unauthenticated or unparseable poison frames are durably dispositioned before ACK. Main focused tests, all-target check, fmt, and strict clippy passed; independent audit pending.

E1.3 exact hash b29b7c9ff25497bcc624a8976bd76b9d44f2bc86baa2ce95ea829179c3ab0745 PASS/FREEZE. Replacement intent is durable before authority side effect; crash recovery compensates candidate, tombstones prior active, and schedules Relay cleanup without stale Active or Conflict.

E2/E2c PASS/FREEZE after lifecycle supervision rework. First poll gates ready; fatal and panic become stable Blocked; generation-bound active permits cover all ten remote mutation routes and drain before non-ready transitions; reads remain available. Final focused gates: pairing 20, projector 31, ingress 17, mailbox 19, bootstrap 31, relay provisioning 3, command protocol 9, fmt/check/strict clippy PASS.

With E1.3, E2/E2c, and Browser UI independently frozen, the sole next implementation line is E6: installable bundle, Relay admin/host/device listeners, desktop loopback Gateway, remote HTTPS Gateway, and a real multi-process desktop browser journey. Physical phone, Provider E3, clean-machine, signing, and notarization remain later hard gates.

E6 is split into launcher composition, narrow HTTPS ingress, installable bundle closure, and post-integration real-process browser evidence. The current Relay executable requires two processes for fixed host and device roles; LAN-direct HTTPS remains production_external=false.

Launcher, HTTPS ingress, and bundle closure passed independent audits after fixes for revoke-before-uninstall, route-specific readiness, certificate verification, Relay v1 DB private modes, binary naming, and adversarial ESM dependency parsing.

Host identity preflight and foreground authorization commands now fail closed before business process spawn with fixed content-free statuses. Final7 strict evidence is BLOCKED at HOST_IDENTITY_USER_DENIED with zero business processes; interactive authorization timed out without user approval.

Strict desktop-browser E6-D cannot pass until the user authorizes the Host identity and Chrome trusts the LAN certificate without bypass. Exact-SPKI runs remain diagnostic-only. Provider E3 and physical phone are NOT_RUN.

On bundle d0bc877e, seven real processes, CA-verified Python probes, public negative routes, desktop shell, independent desktop CSRF, and pairing create/start/confirm/complete reached real 200 responses. Exact-SPKI Chrome was diagnostic-only and did not qualify as TLS evidence.

The diagnostic path showed an active mailbox with zero host_to_device frames because projection required an actionable command capability. Product Host now publishes a valid snapshot with capability null and clears stale remote capabilities; independent audit PASS/FREEZE.

K1-K3 PASS/FREEZE. Noninteractive identity preflight returns fixed content-free status before all business processes; foreground authorization has a separate 120-second window and stable failure codes. Current machine returns USER_DENIED and authorization timed out without user action.

On a real seven-process installed bundle and real Chrome using diagnostic exact-leaf SPKI only, desktop security, pairing create/status, HTTPS join, start, confirm, and complete all reached authoritative 200 responses. This is diagnostic-only and not TLS PASS.

After real pairing the active mailbox remained at host_to_device sequence zero because projection required an actionable command capability. Host was reworked to publish snapshot with capability null; independent audit PASS/FREEZE.

Strict E6-D remains BLOCKED by two user-mediated macOS gates: Host Keychain USER_DENIED and Chrome trust for the LAN certificate. Product commands now expose exact fail-closed guidance and zero business processes before identity authorization. Provider E3 and physical phone remain NOT_RUN.

E6 launcher, HTTPS ingress, bundle closure, and installed-tree parity passed independent review after fixes for uninstall revoke bypass, role-specific readiness, verified TLS probing, private Relay v1 DB modes, ingress binary naming, and adversarial ESM parsing.

A real installed bundle started seven owned processes. Diagnostic exact-leaf SPKI Chrome reached HTTPS join and authoritative start/confirm/complete with an active paired device; public negative routes passed. This is diagnostic-only because normal Chrome trust was not established.

Final strict acceptance is paused, not retried automatically. Exact bundled Host returns USER_DENIED in noninteractive preflight with zero business processes; foreground authorization timed out. macOS Chrome also requires user-approved certificate trust.

A foreground TTY invocation of nomad-web authorize-host-identity returned HOST_IDENTITY_USER_DENIED. Per the frozen security contract no business process was started, no ACL was changed, and no identity was deleted or rotated. Automatic retries stopped pending explicit user approval in macOS Keychain UI.
